params.name: folder_id
params.description:
The ID of the folder to which the entity should be added. This can be a UUID of a folder, or the name of a root
directory. Supported root directories include:
- PROMPT_SANDBOX
- WORKFLOW_SANDBOX
- DOCUMENT_INDEX
- TEST_SUITE

items.docs:
Add an entity to a specific folder or root directory.

Adding an entity to a folder will remove it from any other folders it might have been a member of.

params.name: entity_status
params.description:
Filter down to only those objects whose entities have a status matching the status specified.

* `ACTIVE` - Active
* `ARCHIVED` - Archived
* `PENDING_DELETION` - Pending Deletion

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

params.name: ordering
params.description: Which field to use when ordering the results.

params.name: parent_folder_id
params.description:
Filter down to only those entities whose parent folder has the specified ID.

To filter by an entity's parent folder, provide the ID of the parent folder. To filter by the root directory, provide
a string representing the entity type of the root directory. Supported root directories include:
- PROMPT_SANDBOX
- WORKFLOW_SANDBOX
- DOCUMENT_INDEX
- TEST_SUITE

items.docs: List all folder entities within a specified folder.
